scope: Monster, Fishing, Jester, Event - level and repeatable missions
description_matching: UTF-16 FNV1a 64 fingerprint; avoids redistributing narrative mission descriptions
cautions: Tier requirements transcribed as increments and cumulative thresholds derived; verify stage progress units on the active server.
Fishcaughtweight measures weight, not number of fish; exact weight units need in-game verification.
Killlist contains multiple checklist entries and may not share a single progress scale; keep item-specific native progress separate.
Level missions include stable explicit IDs; other mission files often do not, so they are indexed by description hash.
This derived atlas does not change authoritative server mission counts or force client background synchronization.
